GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (16 Jan 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 608)
16 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Failure to Comply with Directives from Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
1． Reference is made to Memorandum from this headquarters, file AG 370.05 (19 Nov 45) GC, dated 19 November 1945, subject: "Organization and operation of Reception Centers for Processing Repatriates."
2． The Japanese Government representative now assigned to Eighth Army Headquarters is from the Foreign Office.
3． The Imperial Japanese Government will, in compliance with the provisions of paragraph 2c above reference, assign a representative of the Ministry of Welfare to Headquarters, Eighth United States Army without delay.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
